title: The Bronze Altar, Basin, and Courtyard Built

questions.question: What was the altar of burnt offering made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:1-2 (ESV): "He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood... He overlaid it with bronze."

questions.question: What was the bronze basin made from?
options: The mirrors of the ministering women
questions.correctAnswer: The mirrors of the ministering women
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:8 (ESV): "He made the basin of bronze... from the mirrors of the ministering women."

questions.question: What enclosed the tabernacle courtyard?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:9 (ESV): "He made the court. For the south side the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen."

questions.question: Who was the recorder/accountant of the tabernacle materials?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:21 (ESV): "These are the records of the tabernacle... as they were recorded at the commandment of Moses... by Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest."

questions.question: What were the pillars of the courtyard set in?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:10 (ESV): "Their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were of bronze."

questions.question: How much gold was used for the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:24 (ESV): "All the gold that was used for the work... was twenty-nine talents and 730 shekels."

questions.question: Where did the silver for the bases come from?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:25-26 (ESV): "The silver from those of the congregation who were recorded was a hundred talents... a beka a head (that is, half a shekel)."

questions.question: How many men were counted in the census?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:26 (ESV): "For 603,550 men, from twenty years old and upward."

questions.question: How much bronze was collected?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:29 (ESV): "The bronze that was offered was seventy talents and 2,400 shekels."

questions.question: What were the hooks and bands on the pillars made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:10 (ESV): "The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver."

questions.question: How was the silver used for the tabernacle bases?
options: A hundred talents for a hundred bases, one talent per base
questions.correctAnswer: A hundred talents for a hundred bases, one talent per base
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:27 (ESV): "The hundred talents of silver were for casting the bases... a hundred bases from the hundred talents, a talent a base."

questions.question: What was the screen for the gate of the court made of?
options: Needlework in blue, purple, scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen
questions.correctAnswer: Needlework in blue, purple, scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:18 (ESV): "The screen for the gate of the court was embroidered with needlework in blue and purple and scarlet yarns and fine twined linen."

questions.question: What dimensions was the altar of burnt offering?
options: Five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high
questions.correctAnswer: Five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:1 (ESV): "Five cubits long and five cubits wide. It was square, and three cubits high."

questions.question: What utensils were made of bronze for the altar?
options: Pots, shovels, basins, forks, and fire pans
questions.correctAnswer: Pots, shovels, basins, forks, and fire pans
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:3 (ESV): "He made all the utensils of the altar, the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans."

questions.question: What were the remaining 1,775 shekels of silver used for?
options: Hooks for the pillars, overlaying their capitals, and making fillets
questions.correctAnswer: Hooks for the pillars, overlaying their capitals, and making fillets
questions.explanation: Exodus 38:28 (ESV): "Of the 1,775 shekels he made hooks for the pillars and overlaid their capitals and made fillets for them."

key_verse_text: He made the basin of bronze and its stand of bronze, from the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered in the entrance of the tent of meeting.
